definitions: Past tense and past participle of 'shoot'. To propel (a projectile) from a weapon.
To kill or wound (a person or animal) with a bullet or other projectile.
To send out or propel quickly and suddenly.
To move suddenly and rapidly in a particular direction.
To film or photograph (a scene or subject).
examples: He shot the ball into the net.
She shot a glance at him.
They shot the movie on location.
